name: @absolutejs/agent-exchange
description: Verified, model-blind sensitive-value exchange for humans and agents using Agency, A2A, and E2EE.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/a2a.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/agency --external '@absolutejs/agency/*' --external @absolutejs/a2a --external '@absolutejs/a2a/*' --external @absolutejs/e2ee --external '@absolutejs/e2ee/*' --external @absolutejs/manifest --external @sinclair/typebox && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run verify-package && absolute-changelog check
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public
